exposure: type of feeding (breast milk, infant formula, cow milk, mixed feeding)
cohort: 5080 infants under 12 months old with routine visits in private pediatric clinics in Brazil
finding: History of prematurity was associated with infant regurgitation, infant colic, functional dyschezia, and functional constipation.
mod_finding: This study found that cesarean delivery was not significantly associated with functional gastrointestinal disorders in infants.
